title: RedDirt Civic Intelligence Platform — Shared Civic-Data Spine
spine_purpose: Ingest public data once; normalize once; source-verify once; cross-check across agencies; version; audit; reuse safely by many applications.
pipeline: Constitutional Capitalism / Arkansas Civic University / County Workbench / Stand Up Arkansas / Future civic systems

strongest_feature.name: multi_source_validation
strongest_feature.rule: A county employment picture must not depend on one number when multiple authoritative sources exist.
when_sources_differ_record: which source is authoritative for the specific question
strongest_feature.anti_pattern: Treating two similarly named statistics as interchangeable

four_layers.title: Raw source layer
four_layers.location: RedDirt only — credentials and raw payloads must not enter the CC public repo

four_layers.title: Product projection layer
four_layers.rule: Each application receives only what it needs.

projections.receives: only legally and operationally appropriate public statistics — not CC doctrine and not unrelated private data

isolated_schemas.rule: RedDirt is the shared engine, but not one giant unrestricted database.
isolated_schemas.access_rule: Each application accesses only approved views or exports.

public_statistic_display_contract.applies_to: Constitutional Capitalism public surfaces and evidence companion
fields: Original API query (or RedDirt retrieval reference)
public_statistic_display_contract.note: Far more powerful than publishing a bare number. Empty until validated imports land.

network_effect: Every new connector (BEA, USDA, FCC, CDC, EPA, EIA, Treasury, state agencies) improves all consumers through comparison and validation.

phase_2_posture.baseline_rule: Architecture does not raise 2/86; only validated mapped observations do
phase_2_posture.build_next: Formalize RCIP layers in RedDirt; keep CC as snapshot consumer with provenance and multi-source confidence fields

governing_rules: Ingest once; normalize once; verify once; reuse safely
Multi-source validation is the strongest feature
Isolated schemas, roles, and projections — never one unrestricted data pool
Constitutional Capitalism never implements agency connectors
Campaign private data never mixes into public_statistics exports

systems_intelligence_engine.role: Future Phase 9 consumer of validated public-statistics layers and multi-source confidence — never campaign schemas
